text: You see a studious Follower of the Apocolypse.
source_text: You see a studious Follower of the Apocolypse.

text: Please be quite, I am trying to study.
source_text: Please be quite, I am trying to study.

text: We seek knowledge to protect us from the Children.
source_text: We seek knowledge to protect us from the Children.

text: Nicole says that knowledge of our enemies will help us prevail.
source_text: Nicole says that knowledge of our enemies will help us prevail.

text: Hello.
source_text: Hello.

text: Welcome to the Followers of the Apocolypse.  Please respect the sanctity of our Library.
source_text: Welcome to the Followers of the Apocolypse.  Please respect the sanctity of our Library.

text: Glorious Day to you.
source_text: Glorious Day to you.

text: All knowledge is holy.
source_text: All knowledge is holy.

text: We must protect ourselves.
source_text: We must protect ourselves.

text: Who knows what goes on below the Children's Cathedral?
source_text: Who knows what goes on below the Children's Cathedral?

text: Knowledge is life.
source_text: Knowledge is life.

text: Nicole helps us understand the holliness of knowledge.
source_text: Nicole helps us understand the holliness of knowledge.

text: Nicole drives us to resurrect what has been lost.
source_text: Nicole drives us to resurrect what has been lost.

text: I must find that book for Nicole.
source_text: I must find that book for Nicole.

text: Katja must be around here somewhere.  Katja!
source_text: Katja must be around here somewhere.  Katja!

text: The Children have been driven from the Cathedral.
source_text: The Children have been driven from the Cathedral.

text: You were the one, weren't you?
source_text: You were the one, weren't you?

text: Now, we are safe to discover the knowledge needed to rebuild civilization.
source_text: Now, we are safe to discover the knowledge needed to rebuild civilization.

text: Isn't it glorious that the Children are no longer a threat?
source_text: Isn't it glorious that the Children are no longer a threat?

text: Glorious Day to you.
source_text: Glorious Day to you.

text: 你看到一个用功好学的末世论者。
source_text: 你看到一个用功好学的末世论者。

text: 请安静，我正在用功。
source_text: 请安静，我正在用功。

text: 我正在搜寻保护我们免受大教堂教徒侵害的知识。
source_text: 我正在搜寻保护我们免受大教堂教徒侵害的知识。

text: 妮可尔说知己知彼，百战不殆。
source_text: 妮可尔说知己知彼，百战不殆。

text: 你好。
source_text: 你好。

text: 欢迎来到末世论者的处所。请维护我们图书馆的圣洁。
source_text: 欢迎来到末世论者的处所。请维护我们图书馆的圣洁。

text: 圣光祝福你。
source_text: 圣光祝福你。

text: 所有的知识都是神圣的。
source_text: 所有的知识都是神圣的。

text: 我们必须要保卫我们自己的家园。
source_text: 我们必须要保卫我们自己的家园。

text: 谁知道大教堂下面有什么东西？
source_text: 谁知道大教堂下面有什么东西？

text: 知识就是生命。
source_text: 知识就是生命。

text: 妮可尔帮助我们理解到了知识的神圣。
source_text: 妮可尔帮助我们理解到了知识的神圣。

text: 妮可尔驾御我们复兴那些失去的文化。
source_text: 妮可尔驾御我们复兴那些失去的文化。

text: 我一定要为妮可尔找到那本书。
source_text: 我一定要为妮可尔找到那本书。

text: 卡佳一定就在附近。卡佳！
source_text: 卡佳一定就在附近。卡佳！

text: 大教堂的教徒们已经开始行动了。
source_text: 大教堂的教徒们已经开始行动了。

text: 你是一个人来的吧，是吗？
source_text: 你是一个人来的吧，是吗？

text: 现在我们能安全的发掘足以重建文明社会的知识。
source_text: 现在我们能安全的发掘足以重建文明社会的知识。

text: 大教堂教徒不再找麻烦难道不是一件光荣的事情吗？
source_text: 大教堂教徒不再找麻烦难道不是一件光荣的事情吗？

text: 圣光祝福你。
source_text: 圣光祝福你。
